description: Implementation of a test task runner for QUIC protocol testing, managing scheduled tasks and timing.

classes.name: TestTaskRunner
classes.description: A mock task runner for testing QUIC protocol tasks, managing scheduled tasks and simulating time advancement.

classes.name: ShouldRunBeforeLessThan
classes.description: Comparator struct for ordering posted tasks based on their scheduled run time.

methods.name: NowInTicks
methods.description: Calculates current time in ticks based on the mock clock.

methods.name: TestTaskRunner::PostDelayedTask
methods.description: Posts a delayed task to the task runner.

methods.name: TestTaskRunner::RunsTasksInCurrentSequence
methods.description: Checks if tasks are running in the current sequence.

methods.name: TestTaskRunner::GetPostedTasks
methods.description: Returns the list of posted tasks.

methods.name: TestTaskRunner::NextPendingTaskDelay
methods.description: Returns the delay until the next scheduled task.

methods.name: TestTaskRunner::FastForwardBy
methods.description: Advances time by a specified delta, running due tasks.

methods.name: TestTaskRunner::RunUntilIdle
methods.description: Runs all pending tasks until idle.

methods.name: TestTaskRunner::FindNextTask
methods.description: Finds the next task to run based on schedule.
